50881-possum.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It was a hot spring afternoon. Tom Macleod, digging busily in a corner, pushed his Panama back from his flushed face, and stood erect for a moment to ease his aching back. As he did so a motor whirred to the gate, stopped, and a stout little man hurried up the path, waving a capable hand towards the shirt-sleeved worker across the lawn.

arxiv-2106-02579.title: The Willmore flow with prescribed isoperimetric ratio
arxiv-2106-02579.creator: Fabian Rupp
arxiv-2106-02579.description: Abstract . We introduce a non-local L 2 L^{2} -gradient flow for the Willmore energy of immersed surfaces which preserves the isoperimetric ratio. For spherical initial data with energy below an explicit threshold, we show long-time existence and convergence to a Helfrich immersion. This is in sharp contrast to the locally constrained flow, where finite time singularities occur.

arxiv-2111-05080.description: Abstract I INTRODUCTION Fig. 1: Image of a vibrating hopper [3] Computer vision is an advanced computer science technique that has provided the basis for many new patents and APIs that have informed a multitude of applications. Computer vision involves all analyses, including machine learning, performed using pixels of images.

arxiv-2205-04757.description: Abstract Aims. In this work we present the results of our analysis of 16 300 medium-resolution LAMOST spectra of late-type stars in the Kepler field with the aim of determining the stellar parameters, activity level, lithium atmospheric content, and binarity. Methods.

arxiv-2403-10446.title: Enhancing LLM Factual Accuracy with RAG to Counter Hallucinations: A Case Study on Domain-Specific Queries in Private Knowledge-Bases
arxiv-2403-10446.creator: Jiarui Li, Ye Yuan, Zehua Zhang
arxiv-2403-10446.description: Abstract We proposed an end-to-end system design towards utilizing Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to improve the factual accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) for domain-specific and time-sensitive queries related to private knowledge-bases. Our system integrates RAG pipeline with upstream datasets processing and downstream performance evaluation.

arxiv-2407-00201.title: Deconvolving Complex Neuronal Networks into Interpretable Task-Specific Connectomes
arxiv-2407-00201.creator: Yifan Wang, Ananth Grama, Vikram Ravindra
arxiv-2407-00201.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yifan Wang, Ananth Grama, Vikram Ravindra. Task-specific functional MRI (fMRI) images provide excellent modalities for studying the neuronal basis of cognitive processes. We use fMRI data to formulate and solve the problem of deconvolving task-specific aggregate neuronal networks into a set of basic building blocks called canonical networks, to use these networks for functional characterization, and to characterize the physiological basis of these responses by mapping them to regions of the brain.

arxiv-2408-15451.title: Certified Causal Defense with Generalizable Robustness
arxiv-2408-15451.creator: Yiran Qiao, Yu Yin, Chen Chen Jing Ma
arxiv-2408-15451.description: Abstract While machine learning models have proven effective across various scenarios, it is widely acknowledged that many models are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Recently, there have emerged numerous efforts in adversarial defense. Among them, certified defense is well known for its theoretical guarantees against arbitrary adversarial perturbations on input within a certain range (e.g., l 2 l_{2} ball).

It is known that when h ⁡ ( α ) h(\alpha) is small, and d d is large, the conjugates of α \alpha are clustered near the unit circle and have angular equidistribution in the complex plane about the origin.

arxiv-2508-04085.title: Generalising the Central Dogma as a cross-hierarchical principle of biology
arxiv-2508-04085.creator: Nobuto Takeuchi, Kaneko Kunihiko
arxiv-2508-04085.description: Abstract The Central Dogma of molecular biology, as originally proposed by Crick, asserts that information passed into protein cannot flow back out. This principle has been interpreted as underpinning modern understandings of heredity and evolution, implying the unidirectionality of information flow from nucleic acids to proteins.

arxiv-2602-05304.title: A Short and Unified Convergence Analysis of the SAG, SAGA, and IAG Algorithms
arxiv-2602-05304.creator: Feng Zhu, Robert W. Heath Jr, Aritra Mitra
arxiv-2602-05304.description: Abstract Stochastic variance-reduced algorithms such as Stochastic Average Gradient (SAG) and SAGA, and their deterministic counterparts like the Incremental Aggregated Gradient (IAG) method, have been extensively studied in large-scale machine learning. Despite their popularity, existing analyses for these algorithms are disparate, relying on different proof techniques tailored to each method.

pmc-10734644.title: Characterization of dynamic patterns of human fetal to neonatal brain asymmetry with deformation-based morphometry
pmc-10734644.creator: Céline Steger, Charles Moatti, Kelly Payette, Alexandra De Silvestro, Thi Dao Nguyen, Seline Coraj, Ninib Yakoub, Giancarlo Natalucci, Raimund Kottke, Ruth Tuura, Walter Knirsch, Andras Jakab
pmc-10734644.description: IntroductionDespite established knowledge on the morphological and functional asymmetries in the human brain, the understanding of how brain asymmetry patterns change during late fetal to neonatal life remains incomplete. The goal of this study was to characterize the dynamic patterns of inter-hemispheric brain asymmetry over this critically important developmental stage using longitudinally acquired MRI scans.

pmc-11453782.title: 8763 Independent Real-World Clinical Evaluation of Combined Oncogene-MicroRNA Testing for Thyroid Nodules with Indeterminate Cytology
pmc-11453782.creator: Anya Y Joyo, Nathalie Silva de Morais, Deanna Tran, Kevin S Wei, Trevor E Angell
pmc-11453782.description: Disclosure: A.Y. Joyo: None. N. Silva de Morais: None. D. Tran, MD: None. K.S. Wei: None. T.E. Angell: None. Background: Molecular testing (MT) has become common in the clinical evaluation of thyroid nodules with indeterminate cytology to improve preoperative risk stratification.

pmc-11592412.title: Toward Transparent and Controllable Quantum Generative Models
pmc-11592412.creator: Jinkai Tian, Wenjing Yang
pmc-11592412.description: Quantum generative models have shown promise in fields such as quantum chemistry, materials science, and optimization. However, their practical utility is hindered by a significant challenge: the lack of interpretability. In this work, we introduce model inversion to enhance both the interpretability and controllability of quantum generative models.

pmc-12537577.title: Injectable hemostatic foam hydrogel for traumatic intra-abdominal hemorrhage
pmc-12537577.creator: Yicheng Guo, Xiaohong Zhao, Ying Wang, Jing Zhou, Tongqing Lu, Gaoxing Luo, Rixing Zhan
pmc-12537577.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Traumatic abdominal hemorrhage is critically life-threatening, as uncontrolled bleeding in this region can rapidly lead to death. However, there is a lack of effective methods or materials for emergency hemorrhage control, especially for pre-hospital emergency medical services. Here, we report an injectable hemostatic foam (IHF), a norepinephrine-loaded sodium alginate/carboxymethyl chitosan-based foam, which was inspired by physiological hemostasis processes (vasoconstriction, platelet thrombosis, and blood coagulation).

pmc-12644291.title: Bibliometric evaluation of research trends and hotspots concerning the interaction between immune checkpoint inhibitors and glioma
pmc-12644291.creator: Dingwen Xu, Liang He, Xu Zhao, Zhe Yang
pmc-12644291.description: IntroductionImmune checkpoint inhibitors have revolutionized oncology, but their efficacy in glioma remains a major focus of research. This study employs bibliometric methods to analyze the current research status and emerging trends in the field of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors and Glioma, providing a reference for subsequent research in this domain.

pmc-12682510.title: Age-related bone mass and body composition dynamics in female cynomolgus monkeys: dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry insights for osteoporosis etiology
pmc-12682510.creator: Qijun Cai, Huanhua Wu, Zheng Wang, Lu Hou, Zhiqiang Tan, Chunyuan Zeng, Yingtong Lu, Yong Cheng, Jingjie Shang, Yongjin Tang, Xueying Ling, Yuefeng Li, Jian Gong, Bin Guo, Hao Xu
pmc-12682510.description: BackgroundOsteoporosis, characterized by reduced bone mass and increased fracture risk, is a major global health burden. Nonhuman primates, particularly female cynomolgus monkeys, are critical preclinical models due to their skeletal and hormonal similarity to humans. Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) is the gold standard for measuring bone mineral density (BMD) and body composition.

pmc-12690698.title: AIIT-03 3D PRINTED IN RESIDENCY TRAINING AND PRACTICE OF NEUROSURGERY GHANA EXPERIENCE
pmc-12690698.creator: Al-hassan Dasana Andani, Samuel Kaba Akoriyea, Mariela Infante Paez, Jennifer Yenuman Berrick, Rosemond Aboagye
pmc-12690698.description: BackgroundThis is a single center report highlighting the use of 3D (three dimensional) printed anatomic models for surgical planning and postoperative reviews in variety of complex neurosurgical procedures including separating craniopagus twins, depress skull fractures, brain and spine tumors and gunshot wounds in Ghana.

pmc-12722421.title: Self-Assembled Nanoparticles: Overcoming Limitations of Conventional Nanomedicines for Enhanced Tumor Therapy
pmc-12722421.creator: Xinlei Tang, Rujia Xie, Bozhi Zeng, Chengcheng Yi, Hui Su, Congcong Chen, Lili Zhou, Xinhua Xia, Jianguo Zeng, Jing Yang
pmc-12722421.description: The high mortality rate associated with cancer presents a significant clinical challenge, necessitating breakthroughs to overcome the limitations of traditional therapies, which often entail substantial side effects, as well as the complexities associated with existing nanodelivery systems (NDDS) that lack adequate targeting capabilities.

pmc-12997452.title: Why and when does lattice oxygen participate in oxygen evolution?
pmc-12997452.creator: Arun Karmakar, Asha K. Satheesan, Subrata Kundu
pmc-12997452.description: Why does lattice oxygen contribute to the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in some oxides and hydroxides, while remaining completely inactive in others that seem to have similar electronic properties? This Perspective argues that lattice oxygen redox does not occur merely due to high metal valence or strong metal–oxygen covalency.

pmc-12999869.title: Eye-tracking evidence of an association between social anxiety and avoidance of threatening faces in healthy women
pmc-12999869.creator: Hanna Dietel, Taavi Wenk, Anette Kersting, Thomas Suslow, Vivien Günther
pmc-12999869.description: Socially anxious individuals are characterized by higher social fears and a sensitivity to signals of rejection. Eye-tracking studies in socially anxious participants without clinical diagnoses provided mixed findings on altered attentional processes. Investigations of gaze behavior in response to socially threatening scenes are scarce.

pmc-13096523.title: Predictive analysis of greenhouse gas emissions from electric vehicle charging in the United States
pmc-13096523.creator: Mahyar Amirgholy, Faysal A Chowdhoury, Chenyu Wang, S Nikhila Kanigiri
pmc-13096523.description: Electric vehicles (EVs) emit substantially fewer air pollutants than conventional internal combustion engine vehicles. However, the continuous increase in electricity demand from the power grid for EV charging, resulting from the growing adoption and total vehicle miles traveled, leads to higher greenhouse gas emissions from the power sector.

pmc-13239863.title: Clinical Evaluation of Three Direct Pulp Capping Materials in Caries‐Induced Pulpitis of Mature Permanent Teeth: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13239863.creator: Yutong Li, Kangrui Zeng, Boshu Chen, Qiongyi Kang, Lili Huang, Hong Huang, Tingting Li, Yueping Pan, Shujun Ran, Wenwei Xia
pmc-13239863.description: ObjectivesDirect pulp capping (DPC) preserves pulp vitality in caries‐exposed permanent teeth, but clinical evidence comparing different capping materials and identifying prognostic factors remains limited. This study evaluated the success of DPC with iRoot BP Plus, mineral trioxide aggregate (MTA), and calcium hydroxide (CH), and explored factors associated with treatment outcomes.

pmc-13319761.title: Urinary Soluble CD163: A Dynamic Biomarker for Monitoring Treatment Response and Relapse in IgA Nephropathy
pmc-13319761.creator: Saivani Yellampalli, Guisen Li
pmc-13319761.description: O guidelines2 did not recommend any specific therapy, as regulators focused on hard endpoints like doubling creatinine or kidney failure. Later, these guidelines were changed to include proteinuria reduction, which led to the approval of drugs like targeted release budesonide and sparsenton for IgAN.

pmc-13360772.title: Exploiting Device Deformability for Fluid and Particle Manipulation
pmc-13360772.creator: Zhiyang Hong, Xiaoyue Kang, Dan Yuan, Nam‐Trung Nguyen, Jun Zhang
pmc-13360772.description: The ability to precisely manipulate fluids and particles underpins a wide range of scientific and engineering disciplines. Conventional devices for fluid and particle manipulation are predominantly developed based on rigid materials and platforms due to their high mechanical strength, dimensional stability, and compatibility with established manufacturing processes.
